payload.title: File:Vulcanodon skeleton.png
payload.description_html: Skeletal diagram showing known material of Vulcanodon karibaensis. Based on figured and measurements on Raath 1972 and Cooper 1984. Unknown materials based on Shunosaurus (from Zhang 1988), Tazoudasaurus (from Allain & Aquesbi 2008 and Peyer & Allain 2010) and Rhoetosaurus (from Longmann 1926). Unfigured rib, chevron and cervical fragments not illustrated. Scale bar = 1 meter
